subject: Introduce const_sds for const-content sds (#1553)
reason: The change only introduces a `const_sds` typedef (`const char *`) and updates read-only sds function signatures from `const sds` to `const_sds` for const-correctness. No function body, data layout, or control flow changes; the server.c hunk merely adapts a callback signature to the new typedef. This is a compile-time-only type refactor with no observable behavior difference between the builds, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
